Elected officials weaponizing state legal threats against student reporters to suppress public oversight and evade accountability.

Rep. Andy Harris executes a classic Smart Selfish maneuver. Facing legitimate journalistic scrutiny, he manufactures a grievance about 'liberal media badgering' and projects malice onto the reporter to justify authoritarian legal threats.

The Unavoidable Lie: Claiming that holding politicians accountable constitutes partisan harassment.

Actual Article Body:
Rep. Andy Harris (R-MD) defended his decision to threaten a Maryland reporter with prosecution during a post-debate press conference, framing the incident as him defending himself against “the liberal media.”

“The bottom line is it’s not very newsworthy that the liberal media badgers a conservative politician,” Harris said in an interview with Maryland’s Fox45. “What was newsworthy is that I actually pushed back against it.”
